description:
Communities competing for Seedit's /s/interestingasfuck route. The highest-rated finalized candidate resolves the route. Subscriptions and post links continue to use exact community addresses.

https://github.com/bitsocialnet/lists/blob/master/seedit-directories/seedit-interestingasfuck-directory.json
rules: Posts must show something broadly remarkable, unusual, or genuinely interesting.
Use a descriptive title that directly matches the content and does not overstate what it proves.
Provide a credible source when a claim is not evident from the post itself.
No pornography, gore, doxxing, witch-hunts, brigading, or harassment.
Do not falsely claim ownership, flood the community, or use posts for self-promotion.
Be civil; bigotry, threats, and personal attacks are not welcome.
Avoid recent reposts, celebrity gossip, political advocacy, and AI-generated or AI-assisted content.
